definitions.gloss: lost property; lost article; missing item
definitions.explanation: An item that has been lost or misplaced. Used in official, administrative, and everyday contexts when reporting or inquiring about something that has gone missing.

examples.japanese: {紛失物|ふんしつぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{届|とど}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: I filed a lost property report.

examples.japanese: {紛失物|ふんしつぶつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お⟦{問|と}い{合|あ}わせ→問い合わせる：17737_toiawaseru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please inquire about lost property at the station counter.

examples.japanese: {紛失物|ふんしつぶつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I got a call from the police saying my lost item had been found.

examples.japanese: ⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{紛失物|ふんしつぶつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}けられる→届ける：01248_todokeru⟧。
examples.english: Hotels receive many lost items every day.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{紛失|ふんしつ}→紛失：14894_funshitsu⟧ (loss, going missing) and ⟦{物|ぶつ}→〜物：28336_butsu⟧ (thing, object). This is the formal/administrative term for items that someone has lost. Japan has a well-organized lost-and-found system, and this word appears on forms, signs, and announcements at train stations, police boxes, and public facilities.

When you lose something in Japan, you can file a ⟦{紛失届|ふんしつとどけ}→紛失届：20685_funshitsutodoke⟧ (lost property report) at the nearest ⟦{交番|こうばん}→交番：02879_kouban⟧ (police box) or at the facility where you lost it. Japan's high return rate for lost items makes knowing this vocabulary particularly practical.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {紛失物|ふんしつぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{届|とど}け→届ける：01248_todokeru⟧: lost property report
- {紛失物|ふんしつぶつ}{取扱|とりあつかい}い{所|じょ}: lost and found office
- {紛失物|ふんしつぶつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{届|とど}ける→届ける：01248_todokeru⟧: to turn in a lost item
- {紛失物|ふんしつぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問|と}い{合|あ}わせ→問い合わせ：06131_toiawase⟧: lost property inquiry

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{落|お}とし{物|もの}→落とし物：08450_otoshimono⟧: lost item, something dropped — the most common everyday term; implies the item was accidentally dropped
- ⟦{遺失物|いしつぶつ}→遺失物：15652_ishitsubutsu⟧: lost property — legal/formal synonym, used in the {遺失物法|いしつぶつほう} (Lost Property Act)
- ⟦{忘|わす}れ{物|もの}→忘れ物：01758_wasuremono⟧: forgotten item — specifically something left behind, such as an umbrella on a train
